outcome: Poor birth outcome (low birthweight, preterm birth, small for gestational age, low Apgar score)
Transient poor birth outcomes (tremor, agitation, breathing and muscle tone problems)
cohort: Women treated for psychosis who became pregnant between 1995 and 2012 in the UK and their children
finding: While psychotropic medication use was generally discontinued during pregnancy and restarted after delivery, valproate use was associated with increased risks of major congenital malformations and neurodevelopmental issues in children, whereas continuing antipsychotic use during pregnancy did not appear to increase adverse outcomes.
